real_cases: actual SQLSTATE 22012 from an explicitly injected SELECT 1/0 query
unit_faults: driver connect/query/close errors with sensitive messages
later periodic success retains earlier failure

limitations: Diagnostic metadata only; original unknown cause is not reconstructed from later success
One new local recovery control, not a statistical absence-of-failure guarantee
Tests of injected error behavior are not actual operational fault incidents
Synthetic plan/bootstrap IdP/evidence and local file witness; real local TLS/Kubernetes/SQL only
Same local arm64 node and one PostgreSQL server with separate databases, not AWS-to-independent-onprem migration
Final SQL success does not erase first-attempt errors or qualify bounded client continuity
No supply-chain release, WORM, production identity, load SLO or financial-security certification
